_comment: Machine-readable gate manifest for /orchestrate. Each milestone maps to the single command that PROVES it (exit 0 = met). tier: which test tier the gate runs at. requires: host capabilities. manual: true gates run only under K3SM_LAB=1 (else reported 'pending lab', never auto-greened). Gates for unstarted milestones are authored as that milestone's work runs. STRUCTURE: a milestone with BOTH a CI-runnable integration slice and a lab-only slice has two rows — the canonical M<n> key is the integration gate that runs in CI; the M<n>-lab key is the lab gate (two-macs/vz, manual). M3 splits this way (single-node NodePort+PVC integration vs cross-node mesh/DNS lab); M4 splits this way (RBAC/conformance integration vs packaging/launchd lab).
